reader: manual photo reading, Claude Code session 2026-10-19

wall-01.notes: West front gable. Ground level: three round-arched porch openings (modeled as doors) flanked by a small round-arched window each side; upper: large semicircular lunette window in the gable. The round bell tower at the right of the photo is a separate mass.

wall-02.notes: Southwest porch return: a large round-arched porch opening at left-center and a second smaller arched porch at the far right; one narrow window between. Narrow arched windows at the far left belong to the adjacent nave wall.

wall-03.notes: No matching model wall; photo shows the nave side and apse roof from the rear.

wall-04.notes: South transept gable: tripartite window group at center with a round rose window above in the gable; a small side door at the right where the lower wing meets the transept.

wall-05.notes: Southeast wing toward the apse, partly hidden by a tree: one round-arched window at left, three rectangular stained-glass windows to the right. No door visible.

wall-06.notes: Northeast wing beside the apse, a tree in front: arched apse window at left, small windows center, a door with side steps at about 0.8, arched windows at the far right.

wall-07.notes: North transept gable mirroring the south: tripartite window group under a round rose window; a door with steps in the lower wing at left and a small arched opening at right.

roof.notes: Steep red slate roofs over a cross plan with a rounded apse (satellite + side views); modeled as a footprint-following hip. The round bell tower and the two transept gables are not separate masses yet.
